verdict.rationale: Bun's docs say every downloaded package is kept in a global cache at `~/.bun/install/cache` [bun-docs-12]. On Linux and Windows, Bun hardlinks packages from that cache into each project's `node_modules`, so a package's contents exist in only one place on disk [bun-docs-25]. Missing for 10: no documentation that the store is content-addressable (keyed by content hash rather than name/version), macOS on-disk behavior is not described in the evidence, and no independent or hands-on confirmation of cross-project disk deduplication.
